parameters.label: DID / Public Phone Number
parameters.helpText: The public number callers dial to reach this assistant. Used for inbound routing only — never for SIP registration.
parameters.errorMessage: Please provide a valid public phone number.

parameters.label: Extension / Inbound Identifier
parameters.helpText: Optional. The extension or user your PBX puts in the INVITE. Set this when the provider routes by extension instead of the DID.

parameters.label: Outbound Caller ID
parameters.helpText: Optional. The number shown to the person you call. Applies to outbound calls only.
parameters.errorMessage: Please provide a valid outbound caller ID.

parameters.label: Accept inbound calls
parameters.helpText: Register with the SIP provider using the credential's SIP username so incoming calls reach this assistant.
